robot: X1-PRO (with X1 predecessor and C1-D universal humanoid chassis)

sensors_base.value: lidar SLAM navigation inherited from SEER AMR controller stack (not itemized for X1-PRO)

compute.value: SRC-5000 integrated embodied-AI controller (heterogeneous AI chips + coprocessors, whole-body brain+cerebellum control); C1-D chassis tier uses SRC-4000

software_stack.value: VLA-based perception-language-action stack with LLM task interaction, few-sample scenario generalization; M4 fleet management; Roboshop/Robocare toolchain; 500k+ h real-world data

safety_compliance.value: C1-D: millisecond electromagnetic dual-brake, low-CG stability design; certifications not published

availability.value: China; direct + integrator ecosystem; C1-D chassis and SRC controllers sold to other humanoid makers

deployment_evidence.value: wheeled humanoids delivered to customer sites for trials since late 2024; logistics pilots; WRC 2025/CeMAT 2025/WAIC 2026 working demos; 2026 IEEE RAS Product Innovation Award; platform base: 50,000+ SRC controllers, 2,100+ customers

notes: C1-D chassis specs: 650x650 mm footprint (~15% smaller than typical), 820 mm turning diameter, 150 kg payload, passes 800 mm aisles.
